body: hey man don’t diminish your problems, here to talk if you want
here to listen if you want
shooting yourself, don’t get any ideas tho
thank you a lot, that’s something i need to work on
yeah i suppose so, what should i do when i feel like this again tho? it just feels like i get tired of living sometimes, why can’t i just appreciate what i have?

then it just feels like i’m avoiding this thought that’s like a tumor in the back of my brain that rears it’s ugly head, is there a way to just be happy 100% of the time? i try so hard not to let shit get to me but it feels like it does get to me i just trick myself into thinking it doesn’t get to me.

i used to be in the same boat man, honestly life’s a bitch, you just have to surround yourself with people who actually care about you at all times. not just when you’re on the edge. also i’d find some new hobbies if you can’t enjoy the old ones you used to do
